title: Don’t waste your time and money
content:
Dark War Survival is actually a good game at its core. I really enjoy the gameplay and the survival elements. The problem is that the developers refuse to properly manage the toxic players they allow into the game.
Teleport and shield are extremely expensive. Plenty of players spend hundreds of dollars building up their accounts. But one single toxic player can ruin an entire server and destroy the experience for dozens of people. Those who have invested hundreds of dollars (and months of time) end up quitting because of one person who ruins everything.
The developers clearly don’t care. They allow this toxicity to continue unchecked, and it drives away the players who actually support the game the most. That’s why this is a 1-star game for me.

author: [iDOM] VineKeeper
title: [iDOM] VineKeeper (State 645)
content:
I never thought I would be writing this review.

I invested thousands of dollars into Dark War Survival. I wasn’t a casual player who downloaded the game for a week and quit. I consistently ranked among the top players on my server, held #1 positions in personal rankings, built and led an alliance, recruited players, organized events, and even created infrastructure outside the game to support my alliance and community.

My account was suddenly banned for an alleged “rule violation.” No specific rule was identified. No evidence was provided. No explanation was given.

I immediately contacted support, submitted proof of purchases, account information, and every piece of information requested. More than 60 hours later, I have received 2 responses stating that the matter is being reviewed by “specialized staff,” yet I still have not been told:

• What rule I allegedly violated.

• What evidence exists against my account.

• Whether the ban was issued automatically or manually.

• When I can expect a final decision.

During this time, I have lost access to an account representing a substantial financial investment. I have missed events, lost progression, lost leadership responsibilities, and watched the alliance and community I spent countless hours building begin to fall apart while waiting for answers.

My concern is not simply that an account was banned. My concern is the lack of transparency and the lack of timely communication surrounding a permanent ban imposed on a long-term, high-investment player.

If a player can spend thousands of dollars, devote hundreds of hours to the game, build a community around it, and then lose access without being told what specific action triggered the ban, every player who invests significant time, energy, or money into this game should consider that risk carefully.

I am still hoping this situation is resolved fairly and that the account review is completed promptly. If it is, I will gladly update this review. Until then, I cannot recommend spending substantial amounts of money on this game without understanding the possibility that your account may be locked and that obtaining answers may take days or longer.

author: Yesd99
title: Don’t join their Discord
content:
The game loves bullies. It drives sales up. As long as you’re attacked by someone that pays big, they don’t care unless someone starts sxl harassment and maybe they’ll do something. It’s plagued with perverts. Reports are inconsistent. Staff actions are inconsistent. Someone will ask about swapping their game off to someone else and they get removed from the game. Someone else will say they will want to sell their account (which supposedly isn’t allowed) but they’re allowed to stay. Seriously, it doesn’t make sense. People will join the game saying they bought theirs off FB and still continue playing because the staff or volunteers can’t prove it but then you’ll see people say they will give their character away and they’re removed. Strange. 
The game repeats over and over with a few changes. You’ll make a few friends if lucky but if not, you’ll enter a server full of people flexing their biceps and wallets to destroy everything you built and end the game early for you. It’s really all a rush to get high power but all it does is cause the other servers in your cluster to do the same which leaves the other players with nothing to play for. You will also get bored like the rest of us once you hit season 3 or so. Then you’re only just there because you put so much time into it. Enter season 5 finally? Bored. Talking to others in older servers and they barely show up for anything anymore. 
The game will want you to join them on Discord. Just be aware that they use rude people to handle their Discord. You ask a question and they’ll immediately jump in to tell you you’ve been warned even though you only asked a question because you were just looking for info on the game. They’ll threaten to kick you for it. Really strange behavior. Not really sure who trained these people or decided they’re good for the game but if that’s the culture they want, so be it. Quite a number of people I see in the game and Discord hand their character to others so I asked how. None of them in my search for those conversations were spoken to rudely nor threatened. 
All the sudden one of their handlers shows up and threatens me because I asked about it. The game hides a lot, and I mean A LOT of info and you have to search all over the place for it and still only find pieces here and their from other users, not knowing how true it is. Good luck finding everything about point calculations, a deep dive into heroes and all that. Most times you’ll work hard on your heroes but it’s those who pay big who boost their trucks and destroy you. No playing for fun. It’s all about bullying and destruction, not zombie survival. Zombies was the hook that got you in but it’s not about that at all. 
The game also pushes to have you join them on FB. It’s extremely annoying. It’s basically tap the Discord, X, or FB link in the game then immediately switch back to the game to get the gems. Repeat often. There’s not much imagination to games like this. Pay to protect yourself. Pay to feel like you’re winning and no guarantee you’ll meet good people. You’ll feel defeated and like you wasted your money because the game is built on a pay to play system. They’ll apologize and pretend they feel for you but they don’t. The culture is terrible.
